packageRules.description: StyleX stays inside the @stylexjs/stylex range of @astryxdesign/core. When an Astryx update changes that range, the same pull request moves StyleX and this range.
Wrangler pins one Miniflare, and the Vitest plugin pins both, so the three move together.

packageRules.description: Each Wrangler release pins the Miniflare published with it under the beta tag, while Miniflare's latest tag lags months behind.
